title: Order placement and production follow-up
summary: Reviews about placing orders and tracking production are mostly undetermined, with isolated praise for dealer support and criticism of BMW website access during the wait.

positive.summary: Positive feedback highlights strong dealer support from order placement through delivery and financing assistance.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on being unable to access BMW's website to track vehicle production after ordering.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews describe order timing, unavailable options at ordering, ordering without seeing or driving the car first, and attempts to follow production without stating clear satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment signal for this topic is limited.
The cluster combines several order-related situations, including dealer process, website tracking, availability at ordering, and ordering before seeing or driving the vehicle.
